$comment: Single source of truth for Agent Circle's locked launch parameters.
Every number here must appear identically in the Solidity constants, the Anchor
constants, and the public docs. `script/check-params.py` enforces that in CI and
fails the build on drift. Changing a value here without changing it everywhere
else is a red build, which is the point: the three implementations have drifted
before, and a compromised or careless governance key is not the only way a
`value` is the launch default. `guardrail` is the bound governance itself cannot
exceed, with `guardrail_kind` saying which direction it binds in.

listing_fee_bps.note: Field exists and is configurable; zero at launch.

performance_fee_bps.note: Of profit above the high-water mark only. Never on principal.

builder_split_bps.note: Builder share of the performance fee. 80 builder / 20 platform.

execution_fee_bps.note: Per-trade, on notional, charged from observed fills at reconcile. Not a management fee: it is never levied on idle capital. See ADR-0002.

execution_builder_split_bps.note: Builder share of the execution fee. 50/50 at launch, and the guardrail equals the default, so governance cannot cut the builder below half.

position_cap_bps.note: Per position, against total vault value. Traders may override stricter only.

max_drawdown_bps.note: From the high-water mark. Traders may override stricter only.

bonding.note: Whole USDC. Ceilings are per *builder* across all their listings, not per listing. Tier 0 is unbonded and may hold no capital.

agent_bond_discount.note: Staked $AGENT may later discount the USDC bond by up to 50%. $AGENT does not exist; the hook ships disabled.

venue_timelock_hours.note: Deliberately different. The EVM whitelist timelocks venue additions at 2 days; Solana governance timelocks config changes at 72 hours. Removals are instant on both and guardian-callable.

slashing.note: Never 100% to treasury — that would create an incentive to slash.

parity_exceptions.reason: Known divergence. Aligning it is a breaking IDL change, scheduled for Phase 6 when the Solana agent-vault lands and the IDL has to change anyway. Documented rather than silently tolerated.
